A LITTLE MORE ABOUT THE PERSON

Story first.
Always.

Video editor, post-production all-rounder, and a firm believer that a great film is made in the details between the cuts.

I’m Prince. I turn hours of footage into films people actually finish watching.

My way into editing started with an interest in how people feel time: the pause that lands a joke, the beat that lifts a scene, the cut that arrives a frame earlier than you expect.

Today, I bring that instinct to brands, agencies and creators. I like the space where a clear story and a strong visual point of view meet—where a film can be easy to follow and impossible to confuse with anything else.

Working remotely with teams around the world, I’m always collecting perspectives. Different places, conversations, films and everyday observations all find their way into the timeline.

A FEW THINGS I BELIEVE

Good films start
with good intentions.

01

Story before style.

A beautiful grade means very little if the film has nothing to say. Understanding what the story needs comes before effects.

02

Rhythm is everything.

Pacing is the result of watching, cutting, testing and refining. The quietest edit often has the most thought behind it.

03

Leave room for surprise.

A held beat or an unexpected transition can turn a routine edit into a memorable one. Clear and playful belong together.

THE THREAD THAT CONNECTS IT ALL

A work in progress.
In the best way.

NOW

Independent editing

Cutting commercials, brand films and product stories—from the first assembly through colour, sound and final delivery.

THE FOUNDATION

Story & structure

A background in visual storytelling brings context to the edit: who it’s for, what it needs to say, and where the feeling should land.

THE CONSTANT

Watch. Cut. Repeat.

Personal experiments keep the process open. A title study, a re-edit, a short film—each one adds something to the next project.
